podcast.title: Benefit Performance with Mick Jones (November 16, 2002)
podcast.body: The Mescaleros performed at a benefit for a London fire brigade on November 16, 2002, during which Joe Strummer was joined on stage by Mick Jones for a couple of songs, marking their first collaboration in 19 years. "Joe and the Mescaleros played a benefit for a fire brigade in London."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Formation by Joe Strummer
podcast.body: The Mescaleros were a band formed by Joe Strummer after several aborted attempts at other projects, and they were recognized for their quality, even when performing old Clash songs. "But in the end, he pulled together a band he called the Mescaleros."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Last Performance with Joe Strummer
podcast.body: The Mescaleros played their final show with Joe Strummer at Liverpool University on November 24th, 2002, just a month before his death. "On November 24th, 2002, John is banned the Mescalero's play to show at Liverpool University."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Joe Strummer's Last Performance
xref.body: Joe Strummer's final performance occurred on November 24th, 2002, with his band The Mescaleros at Liverpool University, just one month before his sudden passing. "On November 24th, 2002, John is banned the Mescalero's play to show at Liverpool University."
